mapper.select: SELECT w.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", wm.member_id AS "memberId", w.subject AS "subject", w.status AS "status", wd.domain_key AS "domainKey", wd.active AS "active", wd.reason AS "reason", w.content AS "content" FROM workspace_members wm JOIN workspaces w ON wm.workspace_id = w.workspace_id JOIN workspace_domains wd ON w.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0
